evidence.quote: Taking place across selected dates in July and August, Swing Patrol at Spitalfields is a chance to enjoy two hours of music, movement and feel-good dancing

findings.value: Free outdoor dancing in the square in summer: swing dancing (Swing Patrol) and tango lessons then dancing (Tango Fever) on selected dates. A monthly Tea Dance is listed with 1930s to 1950s music. Otherwise an outdoor sport screen and occasional market events.

evidence.quote: Taking place across selected dates this summer, Tango @ Spitalfields offers free beginner-friendly tango lessons followed by outdoor dancing
Step into a bygone era each month, where the enchanting melodies will transport you
The Spitalfields Summer Screen returns to Bishops Square on Thursday 22 May, bringing a season of live sport to the heart of the city

notes: Listings seen on the events page: Swing Patrol at Spitalfields (selected dates in July and August 2026, free); Tango @ Spitalfields (selected summer dates, free); Tea Dance (monthly, date not shown on the page); Fashion District Showcase, Tue 2 June 2026 from 8pm; Spitalfields Summer Screen (live sport, from Thu 22 May 2026). A covered market with outdoor events rather than a music venue.
